Louis Drakeheart once had everything. Born as the grandson of the Dragon King and the son of Earth’s most brilliant scientist and strongest Esper and a Holy Dragon Goddess, his future seemed boundless.
Yet at the age of ten, he failed to awaken his Dragon Bloodline and could not transform into a dragon. Branded a cripple and a failure by his own Dragon Family, he was abandoned, his dreams shattered.
Growing increasingly bitter and resentful, especially after his mother fell gravely ill and slipped into an eternal slumber that no one could cure, Louis transformed into a ruthless, cynical, and deeply unstable noble. Throughout the Frostbane Kingdom, he became infamous as the “Mad Prince.”
In a final, desperate bid for power, he plunged into the Dimensional Labyrinth, only to be ambushed by an enemy nation. Powerless to change his fate, he was killed.
But that was not the end for Louis Drakeheart.
Upon death, he awakened the power of Death Loop, allowing him to return to the past after dying. At last, he possessed the ability to reshape his life, one death at a time.…

sunblind-serpent-the-zodiac-without-a-ho:
Leap year should have ended on Day 366.
Instead, Day 367 arrived.
Earth’s Veil fell. Cities were torn from their places, impossible lands appeared beyond familiar streets, and people across the world awakened Astral Marks belonging to the Zodiac signs.
Marek Vale awakened as Ophiuchus—the unhoused thirteenth.
In the Prime Continuum, the Twelve Zodiac Houses possess territory, authority, and the power to decide which version of reality becomes law. Ophiuchus has none of them. No sovereign House. No permanent seat. No vote.
Marek’s ability allows him to remove injuries, diseases, curses, and unstable powers from others—and imprison them inside his own body.
Nothing he takes disappears.
Every wound remains alive. Every curse continues struggling. And with only thirteen scales surrounding his Mark, Marek cannot save everyone forever.
Earth has entered a greater world as something newborn, weak, and unclaimed.
But the Twelve Houses will soon discover that those denied a place may eventually create one of their own.
Update Frequency: 2 Chapters per Day

the-eldest-daughter-of-a-rural-family:
Pei Qin, upon transmigration, was instantaneously drenched in a basin of misery.
The Scholar father was murdered on his way to the exams, and eldest uncle Jian Shen had two households.
There was a son from the second wife, but neither grandparents nor villagers liked him, and he was also a thorn in the side of eldest aunt.
Valuing sons over daughters, they wanted to sell her to buy land.
Malnourished and poorly clad, her mother and siblings toiled like beasts of burden.
Before she could strive for a better life, that already deceased Scholar father came back to life.
He'd married a rich man's daughter? Sired two sons?
Life was so hard, yet it drove his wife to her death.
Pei Qin looked at her emaciated younger siblings, her hands trembling: To the mountains!!
————————

In poverty-stricken days, Pei Qin led her siblings to quietly amass wealth and silently prosper.
Just as they were about to thrive, another wave of misfortune was thrown their way!

the-huo-familys-troublesome-maid:
Mo Yunxui had spent her entire life raising her three younger siblings.
On New Year's Eve, after watching all three finally succeed, she thought she could finally rest.
Then she died.
When she opened her eyes again, she had transmigrated into the body of Xi Yunxui, a twenty-four-year-old maid in the wealthy Huo family.
There was just one problem.
She knew absolutely nothing about the modern world.
Cars had no horses. Doors opened by themselves. Tiny boxes could talk, and people seemed to carry them everywhere.
Just when Xi Yunxui thought surviving the twenty-first century would be difficult enough, a strange voice appeared in her head.
[Ding! Congratulations, Host! You have successfully bound with the All Works Maid System!]
[Complete tasks, earn rewards, and become the ultimate all-works maid!]
[Cashback, houses, land, skills...]
The rewards are tempting, but Xi Yunxui isn't interested in becoming rich overnight. After all, she has already lived a life of hardship.
This time, she simply wants to work peacefully, enjoy her second chance at life, and perhaps learn how this strange modern world works.
Unfortunately, the Huo household has no intention of giving her a peaceful life.…
